rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, 2004). Bred by Rosen-Tantau (Germany, before 2022).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 2012 as 'Best Impression'.
Introduced in Australia by Knight's Roses in 2022 as 'A Best Impression'.
rows.Bloom: Cherry-red and white, pink stripes, stripes. Moderate fragrance. Average diameter 3.5". Medium to large, very double, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Matte, bronze-green, leathery foliage.

Height: 31" to 47" (80 to 120cm). Width: 16" to 18" (40 to 45cm).
